tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ sangs rgyas kyi dus chen rnams dang gu ru'i tshes bcu sogs kyis ngos 'dzin rgyu mtshan phan yon sogs bzhugs// 356)bla ma dang byang chub sems dpa' thugs rje'i mnga' bdag rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ 'dir dad pa dang lhag bsam dge ba'i yid can dag la phan pa'i sems kyis/ dus chen gyi rnam grangs 'ga' zhig gi dbye ba dang phan yon brjod par bya ba la/ spyi dang bye brag khyad par dang gsum las/ dang po spyi khyab ni/ zla ba re re'i nya stong brgyad gsum la dus chen gsum zhes bya ste/ tshes bco lnga ni sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi dus bzang dang*/ gnam gang ni bcom ldan 'das shākya'i dbang po dang*/ tshes brgyad ni 357)sangs rgyas sman pa'i rgyal po'i dus chen du gsungs te/ dus bzang 'di gsum la dge ba'i rigs che chung gang byas te/ dus tshes gzhan la byas pa las brgya 'gyur du 'phel bar gsungs te/ dper na mar me lha bshos sogs gcig phul na brgya phul ba dang tshogs mnyam par 'gyur ba dang*/ phyag skor sogs gcig byas pa yang brgya ru 'gyur zhing*/ yig drug lta bu 'phreng skor gcig bzlas na 'phreng skor brgya bzlas pa dang mnyam pa'i phan yon 'byung la/ 'jig rten khyim pa pho mo rnams kyang dus bzang 358)'di rnams la bsnyen gnas smyung gnas sogs bsrungs na ma 'ongs pa'i tshe rabs thams cad du yang nad dang mtshon dang mu dge'i bskal pa las thar ba gsungs shing*/ phan yon che la dus chen 'di dag la sdig pa mi dge ba'i las byas na'ang sdig pa brgya 'gyur du che ba yang shes par bya'o// ༈ bye brag tu sangs rgyas kyi dus chen bzhi ni/ cho 'phrul chen po dang*/ mngon par byang chub pa dang chos 'khor bskor ba dang*/ lha las babs pa'i dus chen dang bzhi las/ dang po cho 'phrul chen po'i dus mchod ni dgun zla tha chung ste ding sang bod yul na hor zla dang por grags pa 'di yin te/

de yang sngon ston pa nyid dgung lo lnga bcu la phebs skabs su/ mu stegs ston pa drug 'khor brgyad khri bzhi stong dang bcas pa rnams dus rtag par ston pa 'khor bcas la phrag dog dang chags 359)sdang gis bar chad gang byas kyang ma thub pa'i dbang gis de skabs rdzu 'phrul 'gran par nan gyis zhus pa la/ rgyal po chen po dag dang sbyin bdag rnams kyis/ srin bu me khyer lta bu khyed cag gis de bzhin gshegs pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lta bu la ji ltar 'gran par nus kyi/ de skad ma smra zhig byas kyang khong rnams ma nyan pas/ ston pa la zhus pas gnang ste/ de dus dang ma 'ongs pa'i 'gro ba mang po dge ba'i rtsa ba skye pa'i rgyur 'gyur bar dgongs nas cho 'phrul 'gran par zhal gyis bzhes pa na/ rgya gar gyis yul khams thams cad kyi rgyal po dang skye bo mtha' yas pa cho 'phrul la lta ba'i ched du 'dus shing*/ lha klu dri za grul bum gnod sbyin sogs mi ma yin pa'i rigs mtha' dag pa'ang sprin bzhin btibs par gyur te/ thog 360)mar tshes gcig gi nyin mo gnyan yod du rgyal po gsal rgyal gyis bcom ldan 'das 'khor brgyad khri dang bcas pa dang*/ mu stegs pa yang de dang grangs mnyam pa thams cad la bsnyen cing bkur ba rgya cher byas pa'i tshe/ ston pas tshems 'bru ba'i shing bu sor bzhi pa gcig sa la btsugs ma thag dpag bsam gyis ljon pa mchu zhengs dpag tshad lnga brgya pa lo ma me tog 'bras bu thams cad dus gcig la rgyas shing smin pa la rlung gis bskyod tshe chos kyi sgra 'byung ba de lta bu skyes pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul ngo mtshar ba bstan pa ni/ mu stegs pa rnams ni ston pa'i thugs rje'i gzi byin gyis zil gyis non nas cho 'phrul ci yang ston rgyu ma byung*/ de bzhin du/ tshes gnyis la yul sgra sgrog gi rgyal po u tra yā nas mchod cing bsnyen bkur ba'i tshe/

ston pa'i 361)sku'i g.yas g.yon du nor bu rin po che'i ri bo dpag tshad brgya pa gnyis sprul ba las 'dod dgu 'byung zhing*/ de mthong bas skye 'gro mtha' dag sems rnam par grol ba'i go 'phang la bkod pa'i cho 'phrul bstan zhing*/ mu stegs pa rnams kyis gang yang ma byung*/ tshes gsum gyi nyin/ rgyal po shun+tsi dha las bsnyen bkur zhing*/ zhabs bsil ba'i chu sa la 'phos pa de spos kyi chu yan lag brgyad ldan gyi rdzing bu dpag tshad lnga bcu par gyur pa de 'thung dang reg pa'i 'gro ba thams cad zag med kyi bde ba la bkod/ tshes bzhi la rgyal po in+t+ras mchod cing spos chu'i rdzing de las phyogs mtshams su yur ba chen po brgyad brgyad du gyur pa la spos chu'i char babs pa'i chu sgra thams cad chos kyi sgra dbyangs grags pas skye dgu ngo mtshar la bkod/ 362) tshes lnga la rgyal po tshangs byin gyis mchod pa'i tshe nyid kyi zhal gyi sgo las 'od zer gser gyi kha dog can dpag med spros pas stong khams khyab cing ngan song gi gnas stongs par mdzad pas 'gro ba rnams dad pa la bkod/ tshes drug la yangs pa can gyis li tsa bi rnams kyis mchod pa'i tshe/ 'khor thams cad kyi rgyud la mngon par shes pa shar nas gcig sems gcig gis shes nus par gyur pa'i cho 'phrul mdzad/ tshes bdun ser skya'i grong khyer gyi shākya rnams kyis mchod pa'i dus su/ 'khor lo bsgyur ba'i rgyal po'i tshul du sprul te/ gdul bya rnams byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa la bkod/ 'di thams cad la mu stegs ston pa drug pos cho 'phrul ci yang ston rgyu ma byung ngo*/ de nas tshes brgyad kyi nyin lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis mchod cing 363)sku'i g.yas g.yon nas tshangs pa brgya byin gyis 'dud pa'i ngang nas/ mu stegs 'dul ba'i dus la babs par dgongs te/ phyag g.yas pas bzhugs khrir la gnon pa'i tshul mdzad pa tsam gyis/

'brug gi sgra chen lta bu grags ma thag bzhugs khri'i 'og nas rab tu khro zhing 'jigs pa'i srin po chen po lnga byung nas mu stegs ston pa drug gi khri bshig cing ral pa nas bzung ste drud pa sogs byas nas bsdigs/ khro rgyal lag na rdo rjes kyang phyag mtshan gyi rdo rje me 'bar ba de dag gi mgo la gzer zhing bsnun pas khong rnams rang rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyis gling gzhan du 'bros par sems dpa' la/ phyag rdor gyis mthus char rlung chen pos brdas te/ ston pa drug po 'khor mang po dang bcas pa chu la mchongs nas shi/ de dag gi khrod nas las 364)'phro sad pa'i rigs can stong phrag drug cu ni ston pa nyid la skyabs zhus shing bstan la zhugs pas dgra bcom thob/ de'i rkyen gyi nyan thos mang po yang dgra bcom gyi go 'phang mngon du byas pa dang*/ ston pa nyid kyi sku'i ba spu'i khung bu re re nas 'od zer grangs med dang sprul pa mtha' yas pa spros te phyogs bcu'i zhing du 'gro ba'i don mdzad cing*/ sa rnam pa drug tu g.yos/ lhas kyang me tog gi char phabs so/ de ltar 'di yan chad du mu stegs rnams cho 'phrul ston rgyu ma rnyed kyang*/ 'gran sems kyis khri sogs ston pa dang mnyam du bshibs shing chags sdang byed pa la/ 'di nas bzung ste khong rnams tshar chod pa'i dbang gis/ tshes gcig nas brgyad kyi bar du 'gran zla dang bcas pa'i cho 'phrul/ brgyad nas bco lnga'i bar du 'gran zla dang bral ba'i cho 'phrul zhes grags 365)kyang khong rnams kyi 'gran rgyu ma byung ba de bzhin no/ cho 'phrul gyi tshes brgyad 'di la ston pa nyid sku bltams pa'i dus chen yin par yang bshad cing*/ spyi khyab yongs grags la dbo zla'i tshes brgyad la bltams par bshad kyang*/ bcom ldan 'das la khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis/ bcom ldan 'das nyid zla ba gang la bltams pa lags/ zhus pas na/

dgun zla tha chung la'o/ zhes bka' stsal par rgya rol gyi mdo nas gsungs pa dang sbyar na tshes brgyad 'di la yin par gsal lo/ de nas tshes dgu'i nyin lha'i rgyal po tshangs pas mchod cing*/ de tshe'i sku'i khyon rab tu che ba tshangs pa'i 'jig rten dang mnyam par sprul nas de thams cad du chos kyis gsung sgras khyab pa'i cho 'phrul mdzad/ tshes bcu la rgyal po chen po bzhis mchod cing*/ nyid sku'i khyon rab tu che ba rgyal 366)chen bzhi'i gnas nas 'og min la thug par sprul te chos kyi sgras stong khams khyab par mdzad/ tshes bcu gcig la khyim bdag mgon med zas sbyin gyis mchod pa'i tshe/ 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor dbus na bzhugs bzhin du sku gzugs mi snang bar tshangs pa'i gsung gi chos sgras 'jig rten gang bar mdzad de lha mi kun dga' bar gyur/ tshes bcu gnyis la khyim bdag tsi tras bsnyen bkur zhing byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin la bzhugs pa'i sku las 'od zer stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khyon thams cad gang bar spros shing*/ 'od kyis rig pa'i sems can kun kyang byams pa la gnas par mdzad/ tshes bcu gsum la rgyal po shun+ts-i dha las slar yang mchod cing*/ sku'i lte ba las 'od zer rgyun mi chad pa sprod pa'i 'od zer re re'i rtser ston pa nyid kyi sku re re sprul pas nam mkha' khyab par bstan nas chos 367)gsungs/ tshes bcu bzhi la rgyal po u tra yā na btsun mor bcas pas bsnyen bkur zhing me tog gtor ba las/ me tog thams cad mkha' la sprin bzhin btibs cing*/ me tog re re'i steng na rin po che shing rta rgyan gyi spras pa re re la ston pa re re bzhugs nas chos gsung bar bstan/ tshes bco lnga la rgyal po gzugs can snying pos mchod cing*/ de tshe 'khor thams cad kyis lha'i mig gis sems can dmyal ba'i gnas thams cad mngon sum du mthong ba'i cho 'phrul bstan nas/

thams cad skrag cing skyo ba skyes nas 'khor bar zhen pa chod de bla med byang chub la blo nges par mdzad pa ste/ de ltar tshes gcig nas bco lnga'i bar 'di la rdzu 'phrul gyi bkod pa mi 'dra ba re bstan nas/ gdul bya rnams byang chub la 'khod par 368)mdzad pa yin phyir cho 'phrul chen po'i dus mchod ces grags shing*/ bde gshegs mchod rten brgyad kyi nang mtshan cho 'phrul chen po'i mchod rten sgo mang yang 'di dus mnyen yod kyi grong khyer du bzhengs pa'o// ༈ gnyis pa mngon par byang chub pa'i dus chen ni/ dpyid zla tha chung hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes bco lnga ste/ bcom ldan 'das dgung lo so lnga la babs pa'i skabs kyi dus tshes 'di la ma ga dha rdo rje gdan byang chub kyi snying po la bzhugs te/ srod la bdud kyi dpung rnams byams pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis btul zhing*/ nam gung bsam gtan la mnyam par bzhag pas/ tho rang gi dus su phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis dbang bskur nas mngon par rdzogs pa sangs rgyas par bstan/ de tshe mkha' la zla ba gzas zin pa dang*/ sa g.yo zhing me tog gi char 369)babs/ lha rnams kyi mchod pa'i sprin gtibs/ ser skya'i pho brang na sras sgra gcan 'dzin dang kun dga' bo sogs 'khrungs pa dang dus mtshungs su byung*/ 'di ni gtso bor sangs rgyas pa'i dus mchod yin la/ yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa dang*/ mthar mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus kyang zla zhatshas 'di la yin par bzhed mkhan mang bas na/ dus chen gsum 'dzom par grags pas 'gyur che la/ byang chub chen po'i mchod rten yang ma ga dhar 'di dus bzhengs so// ༈ gsum pa ni/ sangs rgyas nas zhag bdun phrag bdun gyi ring chos ma gsungs pas/ tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyis gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ dbyar 'bring hor zla drug pa'i tshes bzhi'am brgyad la/ wa ra ṇa sir 'khor lo dang po bden bzhi'i chos 'khor thog mar gsungs pa yin phyir/

chos 'khor 370)gyi dus chen du grags la/ 'di ni bdun phrag bdun tshang ma thag tu chos 'khor bskor ba'i lugs ltar na tshes bzhi'am lnga la dus mchod byed pa dang*/ la la'i bzhed kyis/ sangs rgyas nyid rdzu 'phrul gyis byon pa la ma nges mod kyang*/ thun mong ltar na rdo rje gdan dang*/ wa ra ṇa si gnyis po sa khad 'gyangs phyir lam zhag gi tshul mdzad pa'i dbang gis/ tshes brgyad la chos 'khor dbu gtsugs pas/ chos 'khor dus mchod tshes brgyad la yin par bzhed pa yang yod pas/ de gnyis gang mos la byar rung bar gsungs la/ 'di dus chos 'khor mchod rten sgo mang re re bzhin lha khang gis brgyan pa yang grong khyer kā shi na bzhengs nas yod do// ༈ bzhi pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das kyi yum sgyu 'phrul ma sum cu rtsa gsum du 'khrungs pa de la drin lan bsab phyir 371)chos ston par dgongs te dbyar gnas zla ba gsum der bzhugs shing yum sogs smin par mdzad nas ston 'bring hor zla dgu pa'i nya la/ lha rnams kyis nam mkhar rin po che bai ḍūr+ya dang gser dang dngul gyi skas gsum btsugs pa la ston pa nyid tshangs pa dang brgya byin gyis zhabs 'bring bgyis bzhin babs nas grong khyer gsal ldan du/ nyan thos kyi 'khor tshogs dang skye dgu 'dus pa'i dbus su byon pa'i dus yin pas/ lha las babs pa'i dus mchod ces grags shing*/ 'di yang tshes bco lnga la byed pa dang*/ nyer gnyis la byed pa 'dam kha yin pas/ sprul pa'i mdzad pa la mtha' gcig tu ma nges pas gdul bya'i mos blo dang bstun chog par bzhed cing*/ lha las babs pa'i mchod rten bang rim gyi dkyil du them skas can grong khyer 372)gsal ldan du bzhengs nas yod do// ༈ de ltar sangs rgyas kyi dus chen bzhi po 'di dag la dge sdig gang byas kyis 'gyur khyad ni sa ya phrag brgya'i 'gyur du 'gro bar bka' bstan bcos thams cad mthun par gsungs te/

de go bde ba'i dper bgyis na/ dus chen 'di dag la bsam pa rnam dag gi ngang nas/ skye bo tha mal pa sprang po lta bu zhig la nas phul gang sbyin par gtong na/ nas phul sa ya phrag brgya btang ba'i dge bar 'gyur zhing*/ sbyin pa'i yul gyi khyad par las bsod nams 'gyur khyad ches cher gong du 'phel bar yin te/ so so skye bo phal pa la sbyin pa'i dge ba de las kyang*/ bram ze gcig la sbyin na khri phrag gi 'gyur dang*/ de las nad pa gcig la sbyin pa dang*/ rim pa bzhin/ sman pa dang*/ yig mkhan dang*/ lha bzo ba dang*/ 373)rab byung tshul 'chal dang*/ tshul khrims ldan pa dang*/ dgra bcom pa dang*/ gsang sngags kyi rnal 'byor can dang*/ bla ma rdo rje'i slob dpon rnams rim pa ltar 'bum 'gyur gyi tshogs gong 'phel du gsungs so/ de yang lung las/ nas phul gang ni lhag bsam rnam dag gis// gzhan la sbyin par btang zhing phul ba de// sa ya phrag brgya sbyin par 'dir 'gyur te// nas phul 'bum phrag brgyad dang khri phrag gsum// sum stong sum brgya sum cu rtsa drug dang*// bre drug phul bzhi sbyin pa'i 'bras bur 'gyur/ zhes gsungs pa 'di ni so skye phal pa la sbyin pa'i phan yon yin te/ yul gyis 'gyur khyad ni gong du bshad ma thag pa'i 'bum 'gyur 'bum 'gyur du 'phel ba de lta bu'o/ gzhan yang*/ nyi ma gzas zin pa'i skabs su dge sdig gang byas khri 'gyur du gsungs pa ste/ 374)dper mtshon na/ de dus mar me'am yon chab lha bshos sogs gcig phul ba de khri phrag gcig phul ba dang phan yon mnyam par 'gyur ba dang*/ yig drug sogs rdog po gcig bgrangs na khri tsho gcig tu 'gyur/ bzang spyod dang sher snying sogs kha ton tshar gcig byas na'ang khri phrag bton pa ru 'gyur la/ de dang mtshungs par/ sdig pa yang*/ dper na shig dang lji ba lta bu gcig bsad na khri tsho bsad pa ru 'gyur ba de bzhin dge sdig che chung thams cad mtshungs so/

zla ba gza' 'dzin gyi dus su stong 'gyur yin pas dge sdig gang yang gcig byas pa de stong phrag byas par 'gyur tshul gong bzhin no/ gal te sangs rgyas kyi dus chen de dag gang rung dang gza' 'dzin 'dzom pa'i skabs lta bu la ni lhag par 'gyur che tshul ni/ lung las/ nyi ma gza' yis zin pa'i dus/ 375)/bye ba phrag ni 'bum 'gyur dang*// zla ba bye ba bdun 'gyur te// dus mchod bzhi dang gza' 'dzin 'dzom// de dus bsod nams khyad par 'phags/ ces gsungs pas na/ spyir yang nya stong brgyad gsum/ khyad par gsang sngags kyi dus mchod rnams dang*/ nyi zla gza' 'dzin gyi dus sogs la lus dang longs spyod kyi dge rtsa bsgrub nus na mchog tu legs mod kyi/ de ma byung yang sdig pa mi gsog pa zhig lhag par gal che'o// ༈ de ltar dus bzang gis mchod pa dang sbyin pa byed pa'am dge sbyor la 'bad pa'i phan yon spyir ni rgyal ba'i bka' dang bstan bcos rnams las rgya chen gsungs pa dag dang mthun pa las kyang khyad par du/ dus bzang la dge sdig gi spong len ma nor bar byas pa'i 'bras bu ni 'di ltar gsungs te/ dkon mchog gsum la ma gus pa dang*// bla ma'am 376)mched grogs sun phyungs// nad pa pho mo bsnyan mi bkur// dad zas za zhing dge mi sbyor// rgyun gtor chag dang sdug 'phongs la// yod bzhin sbyin pa mi gtong ba'i// sgrib pa 'di yis byang nas ni// byang chub dam pa'i rgyur 'gyur ro/ zhes so/ skye bo phal pa sogs la de ltar 'gyur bar gsungs shing*/ khyad par rab tu byung ba rnams// skye ba'i yul la chags pa dang*// 'jig rten nye du rnams la zhen// sdig pa'i grogs la bsten pa dang*// ma dag dngos po brgyad 'chang dang*// bud med rigs la yid chags dang*// sha dang chang gi ro la sred// 'du 'dzin g.yeng la dga' ba dang*// chos min bre mo'i gtam mang sogs// de dag gis kyang dus mchod bzhi// brtson zhing dam bca' byas pa na// dal 'byor chos ldan skyes nas kyang*// rim gyis byang chub thob par 'gyur/

zhes dang*/ shi 377)ma thag tu dmyal ba ru// skye ba'i las ni bcu yod de// theg pa gsum gyis chos 'brel ba'i// bla mar dam tshig nyams pa dang*// byang sems skyes bu dam pa la// yang yang ngan sems bskyes pa dang*// rnyed bkur zas nor bsgrub pa'i phyir// chos min chos ltar bcos pa dang*// rang las gzhan pa'i gang zag ni// sdig pa'i las la sbyor ba dang*// dge slong bzhi sde yan chod ni// spyi rdzas g.yo sgyus spyod pa dang*// 'dza' bshes blo gtad bslus pa dang*// so so thar pa rigs bdun la// rtsa ltung gang rung byung ba dang*// dkon mchog bla ma spangs pa dang*// mtshams med lnga po gang rung byas// sangs rgyas bstan pa'i sgor zhugs nas// 'thab rtsod drag po byed pa rnams// shi ma thag tu dmyal ba ru// mda' 'phangs bzhin du 'gro nges pa/ 378)/de dag gis kyang dus mchod bzhi'i// dam bca' ma nyams byas gyur nas// sngar gyi las 'bras mi bslu'i phyir// dar gyi pho long brdab yun tsam// dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal nyams myong nas// dus mchod bzung ba'i phan yon gyis// de dag myur du thar nas kyang*// byang chub sa bon thebs par 'gyur/ zhes gsungs so/ ༈ gong du ma dag pa'i dngos po brgyad gsungs pa de dag gang yin snyam na/ 'jig rten khang khyim/ 1 bdag tu bzung ba'i sa zhing*/ 2 'thab rtsod byed pa'i go mtshon/ 3 tshong dang bun skyed/ 4 rta dang khal ma/ 5 'brog dang bzhos ma/ 6 sha dang*/ 7 chang ste brgyad po dge sbyong gis bsten du mi rung ba'i dngos po brgyad do/ ༈ de ltar phyi ma mdo lugs kyi dus chen rnams kyis ngos 'dzin phan yon dang bcas pa bshad nas/ khyad par nang gsang sngags kyis dus 379)chen bshad pa la/ mngon spyod drag las sogs kyi skabs nas gsungs pa'i gnyan po dus brgyad sogs ni 'di skabs dgos pa chung tshe zhib tu ma brjod la/ de rigs don du gnyer ba dag la dgos na/ biṣ+ṭi 'char ba'i tshes grangs rnams yin phyir de kas go mod kyi/

'dir gsang sngags bla med spyi la ni yar ngo'i bcu dang*/ mar ngo'i nyer lnga gnyis po 'di la phyi rol gyi yul nyer bzhi sogs su dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnams 'dus te tshogs kyi 'khor lo la spyod dus dang*/ nang du rdo rje lus kyis gnas dang nye ba'i gnas sogs su dkar dmar thabs shes kyi 'khor lo'i 'du ba chen po'i dus yin pas na/ zab mo tshogs kyi 'khor lo sogs rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor la 'bad pa'i dus bzang yin par/ sngags nang pa'i rgyud sde kun bzhed pa mthun pa dang*/ yang*/ gsang 380)sngags rnying lugs ltar na/ gu ru rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi mdzad pa khyad par can ston tshul dang mthun pa'i yar ngo'i tshes bcu'i dus mchod bzung ba'i phan yon dang bsod nams bsam las 'das pa yod de/ de yang lo gcig zla ba bcu gnyis kyi tshes bcu rnams kyi nang nas/ ༈ rgyal nag 'dzom pa hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i tshes bcu ni/ gu ru rin po che nyid rgyal po in+d+ra bhu tis pho brang du gdan drangs nas/ pad+ma rgyal por mtshan gsol zhing rgyal srid bzung ba'i dus chen yin no/ ༈ mchu nya zla ba dang po'i tshes bcu ni rgyal srid spangs nas dur khrod bsil ba tshal du brtul zhugs kyi spyod pa la gshegs pa'i dus mchod yin no/ ༈ dbo zla gnyis pa'i tshes bcu ni/ za hor gyi yul du slob dpon pra bha hasti'i spyan sngar sku rab tu byung ba'i dus chen yin/ nag nya zla ba gsum 381)pa'i tshes bcu ni/ za hor rgyal po'i gson sreg byas pas ma tshugs pa'i dus chen yin/ sa ga zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes bcu ni/ o rgyan gyi yul du lha lcam man+da ra dang yab yum lhan cig bzhag bdun du me la bsregs pas ma tshugs pa'i dus chen yin/ snron nya zla ba lnga pa'i tshes bcu ni/ lho phyogs mthar skyes kyi grong khyer du mu stegs ston pa lnga brgya btul zhing seng ge sgra sgrog tu mdzad de thog phabs pas mu stegs kyi rgyal khams rlag par mdzad pa'i dus chen yin/

chu stod zla ba drug pa'i tshes bcu ni gu ru nyid dha na ko sha'i pad sdong las sku bltams pa'i dus chen gtso bo yin/ gro bzhin zla ba bdun pa'i tshes bcu ni/ mtha' khob zangs gling mu stegs rgyal pos gu ru nyid zangs kha sbyar du bcug nas lcags zer btabs te chu klung chen 382)por bskyur bas/ gu ru nyid nam mkhar gshegs shing chu gyen du 'khyil nas rgyal po'i pho brang 'jig par nye ba na/ bzod gsol dang skyabs zhus shing nang pa'i bstan pa la bcug pa'i dus chen yin/ phrum zla ba brgyad pa'i tshes bcu ni/ gu ru la mu stegs rnams kyis zas dug can dang mthong dug dang reg dug dang rdzi dug sogs dug rigs sna tshogs pas sku dkrongs bar 'dod pa la/ gang gis kyang ma gnod cing sku gzi mdangs ches cher rgyas par bstan pa'i dus chen yin/ tha skar zla ba dgu pa'i tshes bcu ni/ bal yul yang le shod du bal bod kyi lha srin rnams kyis bar chad brtsoms pa la/ rdo rje phur pa'i sgrub pa mdzad de dam la btags shing bka' srung du bskol pa'i dus chen yin/ smin drug zla ba bcu pa'i tshes bcu ni bod yul phyogs phebs te lha srin gdug pa can rnams thog mar btul ba'i dus chen 383)yin/ mgo nya zla ba bcu gcig pa'i tshes bcu ni/ bsam yas mchims phur yon mchod bka' bgros nas bod yul gangs can gyis mtha' dbus kun tu zab gter bye ba phrag sbed pa'i sta gon mdzad cing*/ yul gru tha dad pa'i gzhi bdag che dgu dbang du bsdus nas so sor gter srung gnyer gtad lung bstan mdzad pa'i dus chen yin la/ lhag par sprel lo sprel zla'i tshes bcu ni gu ru nyid sku 'khrungs pa dang*/ mang yul gung thang la kha nas lho nub rnga yab gling du gshegs pa gnyis ka'i dus chen yin pas/ nyid kyi bka' las kyang*/ spyir tshes bcu yin no cog dang khyad par de'i dus su tshes bcu'i dus mchod byed pa thams cad kyi sar gu ru nyid nges par 'byon pa'i dam tshig dbu mna' bzhes pa yin phyir/

'o skol gdul bya'i dad mos kyi lcogs na sangs rgyas kyi bka' la bslu ba 384)med phyir/ dus mchod 'dzin cing tshogs mchod dang gsol 'debs dge sbyor sogs brtson par bya'o/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa byas pa'i phan yon rgyas bshad ni/ gter kha so so'i gzhung nas mtha' yas par gsungs shing*/ shud bu chos grags kyi gter ma'i tshes bcu phan yon sogs las zla ba bcu gnyis po tha dad kyi tshes bcu so so'i phan yon kyang rgyas par gsungs pa yod mod kyis/ 'gag don snying por ni/ 'o skol gang zag so so'i las sgrib kyis 'thums ches pas ma mthong ba ma gtogs/ gu ru nyid dngos su byon zhing byin gyis rlobs par zhal gyis bzhes pa las lhag pa brjod ma dgos so//

de ltar rgyal ba'i dus chen rnams kyi rgyu mtshan 'di bzhin yi ger 'khod pa gyis zhes don gnyer byed pa 'ga' byung yang rang nyid kyis ma grub par 'gyangs pa las/ slad du don gnyis mchog grub 385) pas nan tan du bskul ba la brten nas/ sna tshogs rang grol rgan pos mi mthong bzhin du gzhan la phan du re ba'i lhag bsam gyis bris pa maṅga lam// dge'o// 386)
